cases.question: Who is the landlord?
cases.note: DELIBERATE scoping-limitation case, not a genuine ontology gap: the landlord's name IS in the document (in the preamble, before clause 1), but chunking is clause-based only (see rag_design.md), so preamble-only facts - party names, address, survey number, land area, land use classification - are never retrievable as a chunk. Included specifically to verify the system honestly refuses rather than fabricating a name, and to make this real limitation measurable rather than only documented in prose.
